files.description: Router setup: BrowserRouter, single root route '/' -> Home, all routes wrapped in Layout; CartProvider + QueryClientProvider + Toaster.
Flex layout rendering Navbar in header, <Outlet /> main, luxury footer. Imports Navbar.
Sticky glass top nav with NavLink to Home/Catalog/Product Detail/Checkout, cart badge via useCart, mobile hamburger with transition.
Cinematic hero with verified Unsplash photo, featured products (top 3 from catalog), editorial origin/roasting/craftsmanship sections.
Product grid with search input, roast/origin filter buttons, hover-zoom cards linking to /product/:id, loading skeleton.
Product gallery with thumbnail switcher, qty stepper, add-to-bag via useCart, tasting notes, trust badges, not-found state.
Cart with qty controls and remove, shipping/payment form with validation, order confirmation screen. Demo only — no real payment.
Product interface + 8 mock coffee products with verified Unsplash imagery. PENDING: replace with backend endpoint.
CartProvider with items/count/total/add/setQty/remove/clear. In-memory only; PENDING: persist to backend.

summary: Premium boutique coffee e-commerce UI (dark espresso/gold theme) with catalog, product detail, cart and demo checkout. All data is mock; backend integration pending.
